tariff.title: Reference tariff

tariff.rulesText: Part: flagged beyond 10 % of the reference price. Labour: time flagged beyond 15 % of the standard time, rate beyond 10 % of the negotiated rate of the region. Supplies: 6 % of the work (15 € minimum). Duplicates and items absent from the tariff are flagged. Compliant quotes up to 300 € excl. tax are approved automatically.
tariff.rulesDynamic: Part: flagged above {part} % of the reference price. Labour: time flagged above {time} % of the standard time, rate above {rate} % of the negotiated rate of the region. Supplies: {supplies} % of the work ({suppliesMin} minimum). Duplicates and items outside the tariff flagged. Conforming quotes up to {auto} excl. VAT are approved automatically.
